title: The Square Numbers
summary: Look at the gaps of the gaps, and try to spot special numbers like squares.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: The gaps are 3, 5, 7, 9, so the gaps themselves grow in a pattern.
points: The gaps are 3, 5, 7, 9, so the gaps themselves grow in a pattern.

steps.title: The method: Gaps of gaps
sentences: The gaps are 3, 5, 7, 9, which go up by 2 each time.
Also these numbers are 1 times 1, 2 times 2, 3 times 3 and so on, called square numbers.
points: The gaps are 3, 5, 7, 9, which go up by 2 each time.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Two different ways agree, which is a good check.

quiz.q: What comes next: 1, 8, 27, 64, ...? These are cubes.
